{{Top}}
{{Quote|How far would you say we've come?''"<br />"''Odometer reads one kilometer. This is one long tunnel|Cadet Leader Kyle Katarn and Sergeant Major Hong|audio=Odometer-DFSftE.flac|<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire audio drama">[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
The '''kilometer''', sometimes abbreviated as '''kilo''', '''klick''' or '''k''', was a well-known distance measurement, in use from the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] onwards. A device used for measuring distance such as kilometers was the [[odometer]].

==Behind the scenes==
A reference to '''klacks''' in [[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Rebel Opposition|''The Rebel Opposition'']] was a typo for "klicks."
